settings.title: What to Prepare Before You Apply
What Does Our SCEGA Permit Service Cover?

settings.editor: A coordinated service to manage your permit application, with clear communication at every stage.
We review the event format, organizer details and proposed venue to identify the relevant authority and the information needed for the application.
We help organize the event brief, programme and supporting documents. Final requirements depend on the event and the authority handling the application.
We coordinate the submission process and keep the application information consistent. Authority decisions and any additional requests remain with the relevant authority.
We track application requests and help coordinate responses, clarifications and updated documents during the review process.
If event details change, we review the update and help coordinate the relevant amendment or cancellation steps with the organizer.
End-to-end event delivery with experienced local teams.
Custom stand design and build for exhibitions.
Audio visual, lighting and technical production.
Seamless on-site and online registration.
Targeted delegate outreach to grow event attendance.
Make it easy for your international guests. We assist with hotel reservations and visa application support so your attendees can focus on the event.

settings.description_text: Reservation options coordinated around your event.
Guidance and document support for international guests.
SCEGA charges government fees based on event type, scale and other official criteria. Fees are paid directly to the relevant authorities.
Our service covers requirements review, document preparation, submission coordination and follow-up until a decision is issued.

items.item_title: 01  How long does the SCEGA permit process take?

settings._title: FAQ first two questions answer copy 1
settings.editor: Timing depends on the event type, the completeness of the application and the relevant authority’s review. We review your proposed dates and help you plan the application steps; a fixed approval date cannot be confirmed in advance.

settings._title: FAQ first two questions answer copy 2
settings.editor: Start with organizer details, the event format, a draft programme, venue information and proposed dates. We review the brief and help identify any additional documents requested for the relevant application.

items.item_title: 01  Can SYNC manage the full application on our behalf?
02  What happens if we need to change our event details?

settings._title: FAQ next two questions answer copy 1
settings.editor: We can support requirements review, document preparation, submission coordination and follow-up. The organizer provides accurate information and authorizations, and the relevant authority makes the permit decision.

settings._title: FAQ next two questions answer copy 2
settings.editor: Tell us as soon as the venue, dates, programme or event scope changes. We review the update and help coordinate the relevant amendment or cancellation steps.
Share a few details and our team will get back to you to discuss your permit and event support needs.
